method: Direct Rust object match arms, explicit enemy/item/hazard/event-family registration, inherited rubble dispatch and manually reviewed room/state adapters; excludes comments, test code, spawn-only strings and arbitrary object mentions. Source Collision declarations establish event selection only and are not implementation evidence. Host replacements and source abstractions are separately classified. Generic callbacks and indirect behavior can require manual follow-up.
